decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-a1ec6b3abdc0] says this is a documentation fix ("fix(docs)") that updates the description of the --auth-token flag in the Markdown reference page argocd_appset_update.md so it mentions an environment variable. That is enough to type the open aspects. The subject is the flag's documentation text, and the change is documentation-only: neither the flag's behaviour nor the release's artifacts change. Applicability is no environment exposure, since nothing operational changes. The exact before and after wording and the variable's name are not given, but a docs-only, informational assertion doesn't need them.
